mainEntity.name: How much does room addition framing cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Framing costs vary based on size, roof complexity, whether you need a new floor system, and how much structural tie-in is required. In the Denver area, framing for renovation and addition work is commonly a major part of the total project budget, and costs rise quickly when the addition needs structural changes or second-story support. The best value usually comes from accurate plans, a clear scope, and no mid-project redesigns. If you get quotes, make sure they compare the same materials, labor scope, and structural assumptions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost depends on size, roof complexity, floor structure, and how much tie-in the new space needs. Accurate plans and a fixed scope are the best way to keep framing costs predictable.
